description: List the master spreads (Musterseiten): name ("A-Cover"), prefix, base_name, applied_to_page_ids[] and pages[] with page_id, index, side and item_count. Those page_ids make master pages readable and editable with get_page_state, set_text or find_replace (scope frame). Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: list_parent_pages
title: List master pages
